findingClass: issue_size (total incl. OFS) falls outside a one-sided plausibility band against shares_offered x price_range_max
failThreshold: issue_size < 0.75x OR issue_size > 3.0x of shares_offered x price_range_max, when both are present (T-452, 2026-09-07: redefined from a symmetric +/-25% band)
unverifiableWhen: shares_offered not yet scraped for the row (skipped, not a violation)
note: T-452 owner decision 2026-09-07: ipos.issue_size is the TOTAL issue size INCLUDING OFS (schema.ts documents fresh_issue + ofs_issue summing to issue_size); subscriptions.shares_offered is the NET public offer (anchor/market-maker excluded). Under this definition, issue_size / (shares_offered x price_range_max) legitimately runs 1.0-1.9x on real rows (Meesho 1.76x, Wakefit 1.82x, Aequs 1.77x) - the prior symmetric +/-25% band false-positived every one of them. The band is now one-sided: below 0.75x still flags a share-count/wrong-unit-down value; above 3.0x flags a wrong-unit-up value. This closed the design item the prior note left open.
